title: framework.config.json
description: Per-consumer configuration the renderer, install-skills, and skills all read. One axis selection per family; init resolves these into a converged skill set.

harnesses.description: Active harness adapters; each wires its files + skills dir.

orm.description: Selected ORM adapter, or null to omit ORM skills.

validation.description: Commands skills run as the verification gate.

source.description: Where improve-framework finds the framework SOURCE (decisions #7/#8).

path.description: Local checkout path; if null, clone repo on demand.

feedback.description: Cross-repo self-improving loop (decision #8). Capture is local + on by default; sending upstream is gated and asked at init.

capture.description: Write scope-tagged framework lessons to .ai/framework-feedback/. Local-only, zero egress.

upstream.description: The gated phase where content leaves the repo. Asked at init; private repos default channel to 'fork'.

mode.description: scheduled-pr: a cron/loop batches the outbox into a draft PR. prompt: only on explicit human request. off: never send.

requireHumanApproval.description: Human gate at PR merge (not creation).
